This seems to be the code responsible for uninstalling apks. It doesn't appear to do anything special to handle errors / nonexistent apps.
https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/blob/ae5db88ff7a3ebc3c564f725f76758c83ccb7973/screengrab/lib/screengrab/runner.rb#L189-L199

This could probably be fixed by using `adb shell pm path ...` to check for the app, exit 0=exists, exit 1=doesn't exist.
